note: What a client sends while a match loads, saying how far it has got. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id the sender holds, that is, the id of the client reporting.

fields.name: playerId
fields.note: Zero.

fields.name: percent
fields.note: How far loading has got, from zero to one hundred.

fields.name: eta
fields.note: How many seconds the client expects loading still to take.

bits.name: count
bits.note: It rises with each report, not always by one.

bits.name: ping
bits.note: The round trip time the client measures, in milliseconds.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Never written by a client; it carries nothing.

bits.note: Set once loading is done.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Carries nothing; a client never writes these bits.
